name: thread-composer
title: Thread composer
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Attach, ask the assistant, and send. A locked window disables send and offers a template action instead.

meta.descriptionEs: Adjuntar, preguntar al asistente y enviar. Una ventana cerrada desactiva el envío y ofrece una plantilla.

examples.title: Compositor del hilo
examples.description: Adjuntar, preguntar al asistente y enviar. Una ventana cerrada desactiva el envío y ofrece una plantilla.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y cantidad.

meta.usage: <ThreadComposer onSend={send} onAsk={ask} locked={{ title: "La ventana está cerrada.", action: "Usar plantilla" }} onUseTemplate={useTemplate} />

api.name: onSend
api.description: Sends the draft. Empty and locked drafts do not send.

api.name: onAsk
api.description: Asks the assistant. It does not send.

api.name: onAttach
api.description: The host receives the files. The chip reuses attachment-chip.

api.name: locked
api.description: Disables the field and send. The action calls onUseTemplate.

api.name: offline
api.description: Disables send while the shell is offline.
